Inside Macintosh: Mac OS 8 Human Interface Guidelines /
Chapter 6 - Control Panel Guidelines / Miscellaneous Guidelines

Persistent Access

A control panel may generate some sort of screen representation that persists even when the control panel itself is closed. Such screen representations should always include a mechanism for opening the control panel. For example, if a control panel has an associated control strip module, that module should include a command that opens the control panel.
